position_rules: 32-byte seed plus 6-byte BLAKE2b checksum becomes 28 or 29 words under the SAME variable-length codec.
positions 1..27: each can use zero-based dictionary indices 0..1625 within the length envelope, subject to the whole-payload bound.
position 28: zero-based dictionary indices 253..1625 (necessary 38-byte length envelope only).

At final index 253, lower positions must reach the 38-byte minimum; some combinations still decode to 37 bytes. The BLAKE2b checksum is a separate constraint; these ranges do not assert checksum-valid candidate eligibility.

external_secret.guidance: No mnemonic derivation extension in this exact mode. Local storage/unlock passwords are separate; never enter them into Tessaveil.

semantic_distinction: Length is output-dependent; not separate generations, not Monero triplets or BIP39. Exact historical release coverage/recovery remains unverified.
